raw_artifact.note: Exact training logs/checkpoints were not recovered into the portable bundle.

interpretation: The in-range PPL surface is nearly flat across tau, while the extrapolation optimum moves to larger tau. Training loss therefore provides little signal for the out-of-range objective; the learned parameter converges reproducibly, but to an in-range operating point rather than the extrapolation-optimal fixed allocation.
claim_boundary: Report-backed values support reproducible final tau endpoints, not a per-step convergence trajectory or optimizer-independent convergence. The tau=0.01 initialization fell into a softplus dead zone and is excluded from the convergence claim.
